test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: DM 12 is related to HQ 17 in a certain way. In the same way, TS 19 is related to XW 24. To which of the following is KG 17 related following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letters → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number → (5) is added to the given number.

​So,

 
• DM 12 is related to HQ 17

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b70369b33347202755d315233a5f8da7910fdbffefc000a53a1478617b71d04.png] 

And,

 
• TS 19 is related to XW 24

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8aec9c8496699602ab9f123d65c4075b210d35efcee44d6e990fe5a25e7011.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• KG 17 is related to :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a58aa4a3eb643eb83ef40e7a698d87688c815eba71dbff9260eb19b516610a3.png] 

Hence, "**OK 22**" is the correct answer.
